fee_notes: Single territory fee is $50,000. Multi-territory discounts apply: 2nd territory $40,000, 3rd-6th territories $30,000 each. 10% veteran discount on first territory. First franchisee received $50,000 discount for three territories as one-time launch discount.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee is $50,000 for a geographic area that operates as a single territory with a population of approximately 300,000 people
